title: Must do tour in Barcelona!
text: Gonzalo was amazing! We booked  tour on our first day in the city to learn about the history and get a feel for where our hotel was at in relation to everything else, and it was absolutely perfect. Gonzalo was immensely knowledgeable about the history of the city and the country, took the time to answer our questions, and made a 3 hour tour feel like it went by in no time. I would absolutely recommend this tour to anyone new to the city or looking to learn more!
